sloka: सहस्रचरणः श्रीमान् शतशीर्षः सहस्रदृक् ।त्वं धारयसि भूतानि वसुधां च सपर्वताम् ।। ६.१२०.२३ ।।
transliteration: sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān śataśīrṣaḥ sahasradṛk ।tvaṁ dhārayasi bhūtāni vasudhāṁ ca saparvatām ।। 6.120.23 ।।

translations.english: "Rama, at the dissolution of the earth you are seen to live on water and sustain a huge serpent. You are supporting the three worlds, the Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas."
